interpretation_cautions: Only one independently confirmed exclusion exists, the user-identified P048 development poster; this is not evidence of broad non-photo detection recall.
A pair of 1.00 scores alone is not proof of a domain exclusion; inspect unsupported_domain and the accompanying evidence.
Seventy cases are assistant-labeled eligible and P054 is uncertain; false-exclusion findings are conditional on those one-reviewer judgments, not human gold.
Keeping the previous combined quality prompt preserves display continuity; the earlier experiment did not establish it as superior.
The saved run policy field reference_kind=no_new_blind_reference predates the completed independent reference work; references-freeze.json documents the actual hybrid reference method.
